Designed for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, the M5 Pro 18-Core chip features a next-generation 20-Core GPU with a Neural Accelerator in each core, which helps speed up AI tasks like LLM prompt processing and on-device transformer model training. The M5 Pro chip also brings up to 2x faster SSD performance than the previous generation for tasks that include importing RAW image files or exporting videos. Additionally, it offers optimal battery life of up to 24 hours, so you can take your pro workflows anywhere. Supercharged by M5 Pro The M5 Pro introduces the Apple-designed Fusion Architecture, a state-of-the-art design that connects two dies into a single SoC. This brings together two 3rd-gen 3nm dies with high bandwidth and low latency using advanced packaging. The two dies include a powerful 18-Core, a scalable 20-Core GPU, Media Engine, unified memory controller, Neural Engine, and Thunderbolt 5 capabilities. The M5 Pro features a 18-Core CPU with six super cores and 12 performance cores. The super core is the highest-performance core design with fast single-threaded performance, driven in part by increased front-end bandwidth, an improved cache hierarchy, and enhanced branch prediction. The performance core is optimized to deliver greater power-efficient, multithreaded performance for pro workloads. Together with the super cores, the M5 Pro delivers up to 2.5x higher multithreaded performance than M1 Pro. The super cores and performance cores give the MacBook Pro a huge performance boost to handle the most CPU-intensive pro workloads, like analyzing complex data or running demanding simulations with unparalleled ease. AI Performance and Graphics The M5 Pro pairs the 18-Core with a next-gen 20-Core GPU. With a Neural Accelerator in each GPU core, the M5 Pro speeds up AI tasks, such as image generation from diffusion models, large language model (LLM) prompt processing, and on-device transformer model training. With more CPU cores than the M4 Pro, the CPU architecture in the M5 Pro boosts multithreaded performance by up to 30% for pro workloads. The M5 Pro supports up to 64GB of unified memory with higher unified memory bandwidth up to 307 GB/s. With all these features, the M5 Pro delivers over 4x the peak GPU compute compared to the M4 Pro, and over 6x the peak GPU compute than the M1 Pro for AI performance. The M5 Pro has an enhanced shader core with 2nd-gen dynamic caching and hardware-accelerated mesh shading, delivering up to 20% higher graphics performance than the M4 Pro and 2.2x higher than the M1 Pro. And with Apple's 3rd-gen ray-tracing engine, the M5 Pro provides up to a 35% graphics uplift in apps using this rendering technique as compared to the M4 Pro. 14.2" Liquid Retina XDR Display Delivering stunningly realistic visuals, the MacBook Pro houses a 14.2" Liquid Retina XDR display. With support for up to 1000 nits of sustained brightness and 1600 nits of peak brightness with HDR content, a 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio, and a billion colors, the Liquid Retina XDR display can handle an exceptional range content with vivid color in a variety of lighting conditions. ProMotion & P3 Wide Color Gamut With ProMotion technology, the MacBook Pro automatically varies the refresh rate to match the motion of your onscreen content. This helps preserve battery life while also making tasks feel more fluid and responsive. This means that the display can have up to a 120 Hz refresh rate. Video editors will also have the option to lock in a refresh rate that is optimal for their footage. The narrow-band LED-powered backlight allows the MacBook Pro to represent the P3 wide color gamut for brilliant, true-to-life color in photos and videos. Designed for All Creatives Photo Editing Handle large image files, no sweat. Edit and retouch photos whether in the studio or on location. The built-in SDXC card reader makes it easy to transfer photos from your camera to the MacBook Pro. Adobe Lightroom, Adobe Photoshop, Capture One, Pixelmator Pro, Topaz Photo, DxO PhotoLab 9, and more, are fully optimized for macOS. Video Editing Craft stories worth telling. Fly through 4K and 8K footage and tackle motion graphics and compositing with superfast render times. DaVinci Resolve Studio, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Motion, Adobe After Effects, Nuke, Autodesk Flame, and more, are fully optimized for macOS. Music Production Produce the whole album. Compose, record, and mix across thousands of tracks with hundreds of plug-ins in real time. Logic Pro, Avid Pro Tools, Ableton Live, Cubase, Adobe Audition, FL Studio, MainStage, and more, are fully optimized for macOS. Apple Intelligence on the Mac Apple Intelligence helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly. Turn a quick note into a polished announcement. Remove distractions from photos with Clean Up. Create unique images with added ChatGPT styles in Image Playground. And use intelligent actions in the Shortcuts app to create automations—like comparing an audio transcription to typed notes and extracting information from a PDF. Apple Intelligence is designed to protect your privacy at every step. It's integrated into the core of your Mac through on-device processing. So, it's aware of your personal information without collecting your personal information. And with Private Cloud Compute, Apple Intelligence can draw on larger server-based models, running on Apple silicon, to handle more complex requests for you while protecting your privacy. Writing Tools Writing Tools can proofread your text and rewrite different versions until the tone and wording are just right, and summarize selected text with a click. Siri With a redesign, richer language understanding, and the ability to type to Siri whenever it's convenient for you, communicating with Siri is more natural than ever. Priority Messages Get time-sensitive messages at the top of your inbox, like an invitation for a meeting in an hour or a reminder to check in for your flight. And Mail helps you summarize messages in a snap. Thunderbolt 5 & MagSafe 3 Thunderbolt 5 combines ultrahigh bandwidth with the versatility of the USB-C industry standard to create one revved-up universal port. It integrates data transfer, charging, and video output in a single connector. Thunderbolt 5 offers transfer speeds up to 120 Gb/s. Existing devices are easily connected with a cable or adapter. And Thunderbolt 5 is reversible, so no matter how you plug in, it's always right side up. MagSafe 3 makes connecting a power cable quick and easy while also protecting your MacBook Pro. Apple also brings fast charging to the MacBook Pro, allowing you to charge up to 50% in just 30 minutes. There is also an HDMI port for outputting to an external display. The 3.5mm audio jack makes it easy to plug in headphones. The SDXC card reader allows you to quickly transfer photos and videos from your camera to your MacBook Pro. Display Support Supports up to three external displays over any combination of Thunderbolt and HDMI ports: - Three displays up to a native resolution of 6K at 60 Hz or 4K at 144 Hz - One display up to a native resolution of 8K at 60 Hz or 5K at 120 Hz or 4K at 240 Hz plus a second display up to a native resolution of 5K at 120 Hz or 4K at 200 Hz Supports up to three external displays over a single Thunderbolt port Simultaneously supports the built-in display at full native resolution 12MP Center Stage Camera The 12MP Center Stage camera helps you look sharp in any light. Center Stage keeps you centered in the frame as you move around. Desk View lets you share your workspace, adding a whole new dimension to make your video calls more engaging. Your voice comes through crystal clear on video calls and recordings while minimizing background noise, thanks to the studio-quality three-mic array. Mac + iPhone: Better Together Use your MacBook Pro and iPhone together in perfect harmony. Left your iPhone in another room? You can access it wirelessly with the iPhone Mirroring app in the Dock. Copy text, images, photos, and videos on your iPhone and past to your Mac, or vice versa. Wirelessly share photos, large files, and more between your iPhone, your Mac, and other nearby Apple devices. No Wi-Fi network required. Keyboard, Force Touch Trackpad, and Touch ID The Magic Keyboard features a 78-key US layout, including 12 full-height function keys and four arrow keys in an inverted-T arrangement. It is also backlit with an ambient light sensor. Speed your workflow with Force click and multi-touch gestures. The Touch ID enables fast, easy authentication. Unlock your Mac, sign in to apps, and make secure payments with your fingertip. The Secure Enclave keeps your fingerprint data safe. Six-Speaker Audio Two pairs of force-cancelling woofers with two tweeters fill the room with bold, bass-rich sound. And Spatial Audio with support for Dolby Atmos creates an immersive sound experience. All-Day Battery Life From pro workflows to everyday tasks, the MacBook Pro delivers power efficiency while still maintaining performance. The MacBook Pro charges with a USB-C power adapter. MacBook Pro and the Environment The MacBook Pro is made with 45% recycled material by weight. It is also manufactured with 50% renewable energy.
